freshly_checked_applications.precise_import: A Cayley-Hamilton determinant over a henselian local ring with split absolutely irreducible residual determinant is the full matrix determinant. The coefficient-defined CH quotient commutes with base change.
hypotheses_checked: R is the original completed local B_p, hence henselian.
NP.span with a=n and the original surjection h.p0 spans all Mat_n(F).
The residual determinant is literally det(rho_x composed h.p0) by OoPt.maps.
n>=1 by NP.a_pos; the quotient is the universal multivariable CH quotient.
The original GDet is a natural homogeneous multiplicative polynomial law on all commutative scalar algebras; CH coefficients match its universal CH ideal.
There is no n! assumption, so n=4 and ell=3 are included.
freshly_checked_applications.human_proof_use: CRW3; CRW4-CRW6 independently add exact polarization, finite original-B continuity, closure killing and every-field quotient/NonSS.
freshly_checked_applications.excluded_scope: No ordinary/control, automorphic, S4 or patched-module existence theorem is imported.

freshly_checked_applications.precise_import: For finite modules M contained in P0 over Noetherian B, some fixed c gives M intersect m^(j+c)P0 contained in m^j M.

P0 is generated by n^2 trace-dual matrices over B.
M is its submodule spanned by group matrices, hence is finite.
The ideal is exactly m_B, not the completion ideal p.

hypotheses_checked: M is the one finite B-algebra constructed in CRW5.

freshly_checked_applications.precise_import: Noetherian local completion is complete Noetherian local, faithfully flat, and has unchanged quotients by maximal-ideal powers.
hypotheses_checked: The local rings are B_p and O[[S]]_(varpi), or the retained actual Noetherian patched quotient localized at its specified prime.
Every completion is at that local maximal ideal; it lies in the Jacobson radical.

Its maximal ideal is generated by the OO uniformizer and D0 variables.
